meta.name: loop-me
meta.description: Grill me about specs for the workflows I want to build, within this workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你梳理工作流需求并给出反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要反复讨论和打磨工作流规格。
copy.tagline_en: Help you clarify workflow specs with iterative feedback.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discuss and refine workflow specifications.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过一轮轮提问帮你梳理工作流程，每次只问一个问题并给出建议答案，最终产出 workflow 规格文件。
howto.when: 当你告诉 Claude 你想设计一个工作流程，或者它发现你生活中存在可自动化的重复模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个每天早上整理待办事项的工作流。
say.note: Claude 会开始提问，逐步明确触发条件、检查点等细节。

say.text: 看看我最近的工作，有没有可以自动化的循环任务？
say.note: Claude 会分析你的笔记，找出值得规范化的重复模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude runs a stateful grilling session that asks one question at a time with a recommended answer, producing workflow specs in `workflows/*.md`.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design a workflow or when Claude identifies a recurring pattern in your life worth automating.

say_en.text: Design a workflow for organizing my to-dos every morning.
say_en.note: Claude will start grilling to define triggers, checkpoints, etc.

say_en.text: Look at my recent work and find loops I could automate.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze your notes to surface repeatable patterns.
